synopsis: Scenic 3 is an open-source probabilistic language with peer-reviewed coverage at CAV 2023 [f14489, f7173]. The booklet rates its off-road fit as good, citing native 3D geometry, occlusion-aware visibility, probabilistic placement without lanes and simulator independence [f7174, f14490]. It integrates with VerifAI for falsification, and demonstrations beyond road vehicles include robotics and a Mars-rover-over-rocks example; the latter evidence is labelled independent and vendor project documentation [f7175, f7176]. However, Scenic 3 is not an ISO or ASAM standard, so adopters must provide mappings to requirements, rigs and exchange formats [f7177, f14490].
